summary: Iteration 14 tested (1) contact email update, (2) password-reset flow, (3) self-service account deletion. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass — password-reset-request creates a doc only for existing phones and returns generic 'Se il numero è registrato...' message in both cases; GET /api/admin/password-reset-requests correctly returns 401 without auth, 403 for regular users, 200 for admin; POST /api/admin/reset-user-password requires admin, updates the target's password (old pw rejected 401, new pw accepted 200), and marks the request status='done' with resolved_at set; POST /api/auth/delete-me returns 400 'Password errata' with wrong password, deletes the user (cascade favorites/comments/orders/views/completions/referrals/password_reset_requests) with correct password, and returns 400 'amministratori non possono eliminarsi' for admin. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): Login screen shows a visible testID=go-forgot-password link 'Password dimenticata?' that navigates to /forgot-password; /forgot-password empty submit shows validation err, submitting a valid phone shows the '✅ Richiesta inviata' success card with a 'Torna al login' button that returns to /login; a freshly-registered non-admin user's Profile 🔐 Sicurezza card shows BOTH outline buttons ('Cambia password' testID=go-change-password AND 'Elimina il mio account' testID=go-delete-account); /delete-account shows the destructive warning card, wrong password shows 'Password errata' error, and correct password+checked confirm deletes the account and redirects to /login. Both /terms and /privacy now show 'info@scienzebiofisiche.it' and no longer contain the old 'info@conoscenzaaperta.it'. No deprecated Expo packages or React Native issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: backend server.py delete_me also deletes the user's password_reset_requests — good hygiene. Consider also cascade-deleting notifications/push_tokens/user_progress collections if they exist; grep shows no additional per-user collections referenced, so this looks complete.

Password reset flow relies on out-of-band communication (admin manually messages user with the temp password). This is documented in the endpoint docstring. Consider adding rate-limiting on /auth/password-reset-request to prevent enumeration/abuse (not blocking, low priority).
delete-account.tsx line 30 uses router.replace('/login') AFTER auth.logout(); this correctly wipes the token. Good.
forgot-password.tsx: submit does not validate phone shape client-side beyond non-empty — this is fine because the backend returns the generic OK regardless (no leak).

Admin endpoint /api/admin/reset-user-password does not require a request_id; it just needs user_id + new_password. This is intentional (admin might reset without a request) but consider logging admin audit trail for security.
Consider adding testID='del-warn-title' and testID='fp-success-card' for more robust future testing — not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ~7 disposable non-admin users with phones matching '+3933122xxxxxx' / '+3933128xxxxxx' (random suffix). One 'TEST_delme' user was deleted as part of the delete-me success test. Admin +393331234567 was NOT modified (its password remained Admin2026! — verified by post-attempt admin login returning 200). Frontend UI test created 1 additional disposable user '+3933345xxxxx' named 'TESTDEL' and then deleted it via the UI. Roberto (+393455119796) was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 verified password-reset + delete-me + contact-email features. Backend endpoints: POST /api/auth/password-reset-request (public, generic response), GET /api/admin/password-reset-requests (admin), POST /api/admin/reset-user-password (admin, body: user_id, new_password, request_id?), POST /api/auth/delete-me (auth required, body: current_password). Response format for /api/auth/login and /register uses 'access_token' (not 'token') — remember for future tests. Frontend testIDs added this iteration: go-forgot-password (login.tsx), fp-phone-input/fp-email-input/fp-note-input/fp-submit/back-to-login/back-fp (forgot-password.tsx), go-delete-account (profile.tsx), del-current-password/del-confirm-toggle/del-submit/cancel-delete/back-del (delete-account.tsx). Contact email everywhere is now info@scienzebiofisiche.it.
